sections.content: The passive voice is useful when the process matters more than the actor.

items.spanish: Muchos préstamos fueron concedidos cuando los tipos de interés eran relativamente bajos.
items.english: Many loans were granted when interest rates were relatively low.

items.spanish: La deuda fue refinanciada mientras los gobiernos intentaban evitar un impago.
items.english: The debt was refinanced while governments tried to avoid a default.

items.spanish: Las obligaciones externas fueron renegociadas porque el coste del servicio había aumentado.
items.english: External obligations were renegotiated because the cost of servicing had increased.

items.spanish: La situación fue agravada por unas condiciones financieras internacionales más difíciles.
items.english: The situation was worsened by more difficult international financial conditions.

sections.content: In the passive, «ser + participio» agrees with the noun receiving the action.
